override._why: The tutorial opens the galaxy map (from about 190 s), where A on Travel gives 'You are already at that location. A OK' and the next press reopens it. From 192 s: A closes the message, B twice leaves the map (in play B only cancels), then no presses so T3-M4 stays in view.
